channel.title: Government Emergency Monitoring
channel.description: Normalized Government of Canada emergency-related feeds

item.title: MP Kelloway to announce funding to support efforts in preventing gun and gang violence in Cape Breton
item.description: New Waterford, Nova Scotia – Members of the media are invited to join Mike Kelloway, Member of Parliament for Sydney—Glace Bay, on behalf of the Honourable Gary Anandasangaree, Minister of Public Safety, for an announcement about the Government of Canada’s efforts to keep Canadian communities safe.

item.title: Government of Canada invests in youth crime prevention in Edmonton
item.description: Today, the Honourable Sean Fraser, Minister of Justice and Attorney General of Canada, announced $2.2 million in federal funding for REACH Edmonton Council for Safe Communities to support a youth crime prevention project through the Crime Prevention Action Fund (CPAF).

item.title: The Government of Canada extends federal fuel excise tax relief on gasoline, diesel, and aviation fuels for Canadians
item.description: Today, the Honourable Gary Anandasangaree, Minister of Public Safety marked the announcement that the government is extending the temporary suspension of the federal fuel excise tax until January 31, 2027, and applying 50% of the regular excise tax rate from February 1 through March 31, 2027. This will bring down everyday costs for Canadians, including truckers and businesses in the food, agriculture, housing, construction, and delivery sectors.

item.title: The Government of Canada extends federal fuel excise tax relief on gasoline, diesel, and aviation fuels for Canadians
item.description: The world is changing rapidly. The United States is imposing new tariffs on Canada, designed to hurt and divide us. At the same time, conflicts in Europe and the Middle East are driving up prices around the world. In response, Canada’s government is focused on what we can control: building a stronger, more independent, and more affordable country.

item.title: Minister Anandasangaree to highlight affordability measures in Brantford
item.description: Members of the media are invited to join the Honourable Gary Anandasangaree, Minister of Public Safety, to highlight affordability measures introduced by the Government of Canada to help Canadians facing rising fuel costs.

item.title: Government of Canada matches donations to the Red Cross’ 2026 Manitoba Flood Appeal
item.description: Today, the Honourable Eleanor Olszewski, Minister of Emergency Management and Community Resilience and Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, announced that the Government of Canada is matching donations made to the Canadian Red Cross’ 2026 appeal for flooding in Manitoba.

item.title: Government of Canada to match donations to the Red Cross’ 2026 British Columbia Wildfires Appeal
item.description: Today, the Honourable Eleanor Olszewski, Minister of Emergency Management and Community Resilience and Minister responsible for Prairies Economic Development Canada, announced that the Government of Canada will match donations to the Canadian Red Cross’ 2026 British Columbia Wildfires Appeal in support of wildfires disaster relief and recovery efforts in British Columbia (B.C.).

item.title: Government of Canada announces funding for Indigenous-led alternatives to incarceration in Manitoba
item.description: Today, the Honourable Rebecca Chartrand, Minister of Northern and Arctic Affairs and Minister responsible for the Canadian Northern Economic Development Agency, on behalf of the Honourable Gary Anandasangaree, Minister of Public Safety, announced $5 million in federal funding to the Manitoba Keewatinowi Okimakanak (MKO) to support Indigenous-led alternatives to incarceration for First Nations individuals.

item.title: The Government of Canada provides an update regarding the 2026 wildfire season – August update
item.description: As of today, there are 582 active wildfires nationally including 31 that are out of control, with full response. In total this season, there have been 4,793 fires and 4.1 million hectares burned. Last year we saw fewer fires at this time – 4,584 fires by mid-August - but a more significant number of hectares burned – 7.7 million.
